briefing.headline: OpenAI and xAI escalate multi-agent AGI race with coordinated model releases

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AGI race has intensified with frontier labs releasing advanced reasoning models amid rising geopolitical stakes. Funding continues at record pace while safety gaps persist. Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI deployed o4 with native multi-agent orchestration while xAI's Grok-4.5 demonstrated real-time dialect adaptation. DeepSeek-V3.1 and Meta's Llama-4-Reasoning closed the gap on coding benchmarks. Anthropic's Claude 4 Opus leads in constitutional safety metrics.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: New exploits target agentic workflows across cloud providers. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent, automotive, and BCI deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA announced Blackwell Ultra clusters shipping to Microsoft and CoreWeave. Google expanded TPU v6 pods in Europe while Saudi Arabia committed $4B to sovereign AI data centers.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will protocol-level security like dynamic dialects become mandatory before 2028 AGI deployments?
